description: This file defines classes and functions related to manifest items for web platform tests, including URL-based test representations, test types, and support files.

classes.name: ManifestItem
classes.description: Abstract base class for manifest items, providing common properties and methods for test identification and comparison.

classes.name: URLManifestItem
classes.description: Represents a test item identified by a URL, with support for URL joining and JSON serialization.

classes.name: TestharnessTest
classes.description: A specific type of URLManifestItem representing testharness tests, with optional timeout.

classes.name: RefTestNode
classes.description: Represents a reftest node with references, timeout, viewport size, and DPI, capable of converting to other test types.

classes.name: RefTest
classes.description: A reftest type derived from RefTestNode.

classes.name: ConformanceCheckerTest
classes.description: Represents a conformance checker test type.

classes.name: WebdriverSpecTest
classes.description: Represents a WebDriver specification test with optional timeout.

classes.name: SupportFile
classes.description: Represents a support file associated with tests.

methods.name: get_source_file
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a SourceFile object for a given path, managing source files cache.
